{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America consistently supported the Palestinian right to a sovereign state on the West Bank and Gaza Strip.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America consistently supported Israel’s right to retain its character as a majority Jewish state.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Israel should accord full political and civil rights to Palestinians and Jews, whether secular or religious, as well as to other national and religious minorities, without qualification.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America reaffirms its commitment today to supporting the Palestinian right to a sovereign state on the West Bank and Gaza Strip and Israel’s right to retain its character as a majority Jewish state.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The greatest barrier to peace is the Sharon government’s efforts to de facto annex most of the occupied territories.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The wall being built by the Israeli government is said to be a defense against terror attacks and protection for isolated, illegal and – in DSA’s view – undesirable Israeli settlements.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The creation of the wall, whether purposeful or not, will divide Palestinian communities in a manner that precludes the creation of an independent Palestinian state.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The occupation contributes to a profound sense of humiliation and resentment as Palestinians continue to live under the most dire conditions.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Israeli government’s policy of administering collective punishment, including road blocks, military incursions, the demolition of homes and the wholesale closure of the territories, is self–defeating.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Israeli government’s policy of administering collective punishment contributes to mass unemployment, economic destitution and homelessness.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Israeli government’s policy of administering collective punishment increases the pool of extremist recruits and threatens the viability of Palestinian communities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
